redo 전송과 대기 리두 로그: Redo transport and standby redo logs
새벽 3시, 주 DB 서버의 저장 장치가 망가졌다: 3 a.m.: the primary server's storage has failed
03:05, dbserver02의 저장 장치 컨트롤러가 고장 나 주 DB: At 03:05 the storage controller on dbserver02 failed and the primary database (orcl) stopped. The infrastructure team says getting a part and repairing it will take a day. To keep the order service running, the standby database (orclstby) on dbserver03 must become the primary.
DBA 실습의 스위치오버는 두 DB가 다 살아 있을 때의 계획된 전환이었: The switchover in the DBA labs was a planned transition with both databases alive. This time the primary is gone. Before deciding, the question to ask is how far the standby had received, and therefore what might be lost.
이 레슨은 redo가 주 DB에서 대기 DB로 건너가는 길을 따라가며 그: This lesson answers that question by following the path redo takes from the primary to the standby. It continues the redo of "The journey of a COMMIT" and "Archivelog and RMAN" onto another server.
주 DB와 물리 대기 DB: 블록 하나까지 같은 복제본: Primary and physical standby: a copy identical block for block
Data Guard 구성은 주 DB 하나와 대기 DB 여럿(문서 기준 최: A Data Guard configuration consists of one primary and one or more standbys (up to thirty, per the documentation). A physical standby is a block-for-block identical copy of the primary and keeps up by applying the primary's redo as is (Redo Apply).
DBA 실습처럼 두 DB의 이름(NAME)은 ORCL로 같고, <code: As in the DBA labs, both databases have the same NAME, ORCL, and are told apart by DB_UNIQUE_NAME (orcl, orclstby) and role (DATABASE_ROLE). The standby is usually mounted and only applies redo. Opening it read-only while applying requires an Active Data Guard license.
데이터 파일을 복사하는 것이 아니라 redo를 보내 같은 변경을 다시 하: It does not copy data files; it sends redo so the same changes are made again. So how much of the primary's redo has reached the standby is how current the standby is.
redo 전송: 주 DB의 redo가 대기 DB의 대기 리두 로그로: Redo transport: the primary's redo into the standby redo log
When a transaction commits on the primary, LGWR writes redo to the online redo log. Data Guard redo transport sends this redo to the standby, where RFS (remote file server) receives it and writes it to the standby redo log.
문서에 따르면 SYNC든 ASYNC든 전송하려면 받는 쪽에 대기 리두 로: According to the documentation, both SYNC and ASYNC transport require standby redo logs at the destination. When a standby redo log group fills and the next one is used, ARCn on the standby archives that group.
네트워크가 잠시 끊겨 빠진 redo가 생기면(gap), Data Guar: If a network interruption leaves missing redo (a gap), Data Guard automatically retrieves the missing archived logs (automatic gap resolution).
+ redo 전송 → RFS → 대기 리두 로그: + redo transport → RFS → standby redo log
Redo Apply: MRP0가 받은 redo를 데이터 파일에 다시 한다: Redo Apply: MRP0 replays received redo into the data files
적용이 멈추면(브로커 상태 APPLY-OFF) redo는 계속 도착하지만: If apply stops (broker state APPLY-OFF), redo keeps arriving but the data files fall behind. The 2-hour Apply Lag in DBA lab 82 was exactly this state.
적용이 밀려 있으면 페일오버 때 그 redo를 모두 적용해야 주 DB로: If apply is behind, all that redo must be applied before the database can open as primary at failover. Apply lag is the time a role transition will take.
+ MRP0: 대기 리두 로그 → 데이터 파일: + MRP0: standby redo log → data files
SYNC냐 ASYNC냐: 보호 모드가 정하는 \"잃어도 되는 양\": SYNC or ASYNC: protection modes decide how much may be lost
문서에 따르면 <b>SYNC</b> 전송에서는 redo가 대기 DB로 전: According to the documentation, with SYNC transport a transaction cannot finish committing until its redo has been sent to the standby, while ASYNC commits without waiting. ASYNC keeps the primary fast, but some redo may not have crossed yet.
보호 모드는 셋입니다. <b>최대 성능</b>(기본, ASYNC), <b: There are three protection modes: maximum performance (the default, ASYNC), maximum availability (SYNC, behaving like maximum performance if the standby is unavailable), and maximum protection (the primary shuts down rather than continue if it cannot write to a standby). orcl_dg uses maximum performance.
1장면의 질문에 대한 답의 절반입니다. 최대 성능 모드에서는 주 DB가: This is half the answer to the question in scene 1. In maximum performance mode, when the primary dies suddenly, redo not yet sent, and with it that many committed transactions, can be lost.
두 가지 지연: 아직 안 온 redo, 와 있지만 아직 안 적용된 red: Two lags: redo not yet arrived, and redo arrived but not yet applied
대기 DB의 <code>V$DATAGUARD_STATS</code>에서: In the standby's V$DATAGUARD_STATS, transport lag shows, as time, the redo generated on the primary that has not reached the standby, and apply lag the redo that has arrived but is not yet applied. The documentation explains these are computed from data received from the primary.
페일오버에서 잃을 수 있는 것은 transport lag만큼이고, 전환에: What failover can lose is the transport lag; how long the transition takes is the apply lag (and apply finish time). That is why these two values are part of the daily morning check.
이 뷰는 대기 DB에서 봅니다. DBA 실습 레슨 81에서 확인했듯 주: Query this view on the standby. As in DBA lab 81, it returns no rows on the primary.
~ transport lag = 아직 안 온 redo: ~ transport lag = redo not yet arrived
~ apply lag = 아직 적용 안 된 redo: ~ apply lag = redo not yet applied
브로커: 두 DB를 하나의 구성으로 관리하는 DGMGRL: The broker: DGMGRL manages both databases as one configuration
Data Guard 브로커는 주 DB와 대기 DB를 하나의 구성(orcl: The Data Guard broker manages the primary and standby together as one configuration (orcl_dg). DGMGRL's show configuration gives the overall status, and show database each member's state (APPLY-ON, APPLY-OFF, TRANSPORT-ON, TRANSPORT-OFF).
역할 전환도 브로커가 명령 하나로 합니다. 문서는 <code>VALIDA: The broker also performs role transitions with a single command. The documentation recommends checking readiness before a role change with VALIDATE DATABASE. In a broker configuration, change state with DGMGRL, not SQL*Plus.
DBA 실습 10단계에서 show configuration, show d: In DBA labs stage 10 you used show configuration, show database, validate database and switchover.
<span class=\"term\">스위치오버</span>는 두 DB가: Switchover is a planned transition that swaps roles while both databases are alive. As the documentation says, there is no data loss, and it can be reversed later. It is used for patching or hardware replacement.
<span class=\"term\">페일오버</span>는 주 DB를: Failover promotes the standby to primary when the primary is lost. According to the documentation, some data may be lost unless the configuration is in maximum protection or maximum availability mode. If Flashback Database was enabled on the old primary, it can be reinstated as the new standby after repair.
페일오버는 되돌리기 어려운 결정입니다. 주 DB를 정말 살릴 수 없는지,: Failover is a hard-to-reverse decision. Confirm the primary truly cannot be recovered and how much could be lost, and proceed on the business owner's decision.
사례: 지연을 확인하고 FAILOVER, 고친 뒤 REINSTATE: Case: check the lag, FAILOVER, then REINSTATE after repair
대기 DB에서 지연부터 봅니다. transport lag 2초, appl: Start with the lag on the standby. With transport lag 2 s and apply lag 3 s, what maximum performance mode can lose is the last few seconds of commits. After the business owner decides, run FAILOVER TO orclstby; in DGMGRL connected to the standby. According to the Broker documentation, the default complete failover applies all received redo before changing the role to primary and opening the database. IMMEDIATE skips applying and usually loses data, so use it only when a complete failover is not possible.
페일오버 뒤에 앱이 새 주 DB(dbserver03)로 접속하는지 꼭 확: After failover, make sure the app connects to the new primary (dbserver03). With the broker's fast-start failover, the broker can also fail over automatically to a preselected standby when the primary is lost.
-- 하루 뒤, dbserver02 수리 후 orcl을 마운트까지 올리고: -- a day later, orcl started to mount after dbserver02 repair
정리: redo가 건너간 만큼 지킨다: Recap: you keep what redo has crossed
주 DB의 redo는 전송되어 대기 DB의 RFS가 대기 리두 로그에 쓰: The primary's redo is transported, written by the standby's RFS into the standby redo log, and applied to the data files by MRP0. The protection mode decides SYNC or ASYNC, and therefore what can be lost if the primary is lost.
transport lag는 잃을 수 있는 양, apply lag는 전환에: Transport lag is what you could lose; apply lag is how long a transition takes. Use switchover for planned work, failover when the primary is lost, and reinstate the repaired old primary with Flashback Database.
The next lesson, "RAC", is about several servers opening one database together. If Data Guard is a copy elsewhere, RAC is several instances of the same database.
명령 한 줄의 여정: The journey of one command line
대기 DB에서는 <span class=\"term\">MRP</span>: On the standby, MRP (managed recovery process, MRP0) applies received redo to the data files. The documented command is ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE DISCONNECT, and if standby redo logs exist, starting Redo Apply automatically enables real-time apply, which applies redo as it arrives in the standby redo log instead of waiting for a log switch.
하루 뒤 dbserver02를 고치면 옛 주 DB(orcl)는 <code: A day later, when dbserver02 is repaired, the old primary (orcl) shows ORA-16661 (the standby database needs to be reinstated). If Flashback Database was enabled before the failover and there are enough flashback logs, start orcl to mount, connect to the new primary, and bring it back as the new standby with REINSTATE DATABASE orcl;. Otherwise the standby must be re-created (ORA-16795).
